acceptance_targets: Branded nominal types Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick exported with validator constructors that reject non-integer and out-of-range values
Arithmetic helpers for bigint multiplication and division with explicit rounding modes (TRUNCATE_TOWARD_ZERO, ROUND_HALF_UP, ROUND_HALF_EVEN) that emit residue
Positional RNG function rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) -> uint64 with no mutable state
ADR written for hash function (resolving ADR-002 DEFINIR; recommended SplitMix64 over FNV-1a accumulator)

CanonicalEncoder implemented per ADR-009: UTF-8 byte-sorted keys, bigint as signed decimal ASCII, safe integer with type marker, rejection of undefined/NaN/Infinity/-0, ordered and unordered collection encoding
ADR-009 written and committed to docs/decisions/ before any StateHash computation exists
Lint passes on all core sources; no transcendental functions, no float literals, no Math.random
Unit tests covering type rejection, arithmetic edge cases, RNG determinism, and encoder round-trip for logically equal vs logically distinct states
proposals.title: Implement packages/core: nominal types, arithmetic, positional RNG, and CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: Every other FASE-1 package (world, domain, application) has packages/core as its only dependency. The package currently exports nothing. The FASE-1 acceptance criterion explicitly requires ADR-009 written and the CanonicalEncoder implemented before any state hash exists. Nothing else can be built or tested until core is populated. All FASE-1 invariants that touch arithmetic, hash, or encoding (INV-12, INV-22, INV-23, INV-26) are blocked on this.

acceptance_targets: price(assetId, tick) -> Price implemented as pure positional function using rand() from core, with two fractal noise octaves in fixed-point log-space
Two assets with distinct archetypes (e.g. ORB blue-chip, VOLT high-volatility) and their logPrice0 baseline and volBase parameters in a versioned config file
No OHLC at the base tick level; candle aggregation is a pure read projection over the tick sequence
INV-02 test: direct query at tick 1000 equals the value produced by stepping tick-by-tick from 0 to 1000
INV-03 test: two calls with different player action histories produce identical worldPrice series
ADR written for octave count, periods, and amplitudes (resolving the DEFINIR in §5.1), with a hash-compatible parameter file
All world sources pass lint; no floating-point, no transcendental functions
proposals.title: Implement packages/world: deterministic price generator with two noise layers and two assets
proposals.why_now: packages/world is the second link in the dependency chain and is required for FASE-1 acceptance. INV-02 (direct price query equals tick-by-tick traversal) and INV-03 (player actions do not alter world price) cannot be green without it. The price generator is also the primary determinism test surface: it must produce identical output on direct access and on sequential advancement, which is the most important test in the project per the spec.

acceptance_targets: Transaction type with per-commodity zero-sum enforcement; construction outside a Transaction is a type error
All required accounts defined (player:cash:BRL, player:spot:<ASSET>, world:counterparty_cash, world:asset_supply:<ASSET>, world:rounding_residue:<COMMODITY>, venue:fees)
Market order (buy and sell spot) execution: notional computed in bigint, fee deducted, rounding residue captured and posted to world:rounding_residue
INV-04 enforced as a runtime invariant on every Transaction commit
INV-05 and INV-06 enforced in property tests covering 1000 random order sequences
INV-07 property test: sum of all rounding residues equals exact difference between nominal and truncated totals by commodity
All domain sources pass lint; every division carries explicit rounding mode
proposals.title: Implement packages/domain: double-entry multi-commodity ledger and spot market orders
proposals.why_now: The ledger is the FASE-1 economic core: INV-04 (per-commodity zero-sum transactions), INV-05 (BRL sum is zero across all accounts), INV-06 (asset quantity sum is zero), and INV-07 (rounding residue fully accounts for truncation) all live here. Market order buy/sell spot with maker/taker fees and rounding-residue lancing is required by FASE-1 scope. Without domain, there is no economic state to hash, no replay to verify, and no INV-01 to test.

acceptance_targets: Canonical tick loop implements all ten steps from §7 in declared order with a test that verifies step ordering

Save envelope with specVersion, rulesetVersion, encodingVersion, masterSeed, finalTick, actions array; structural validation rejects saves where finalTick < max(action.tick) or where (tick, sequence) is not unique
SaveHash and StateHash computed via CanonicalEncoder; finalTick excluded from StateHash per ADR-009
tools/replay CLI accepts two save files and reports either 'identical' or the first tick where StateHash diverges, with the diverging values
INV-01 integration test: replay of a three-action save produces the same StateHash at every tick as the live session that created it
INV-11 test: advance from tick 0 to tick 500 in steps of 1, then 100, then direct jump; all three produce the same StateHash
INV-21 test: save with action.tick > finalTick is rejected on load
proposals.title: Implement packages/application tick loop, save format, and tools/replay CLI
proposals.why_now: The canonical tick processing order (§7) must live in one place and be tested for correct ordering. The save format (ADR-006) is the unit of reproduction for every bug report and is required for INV-01, INV-21, INV-22. tools/replay is a FASE-1 acceptance target: it must compare two executions and report the first divergent tick. INV-11 (1-tick, 100-tick, and direct-jump produce identical StateHash) cannot be green without the tick loop. This is the integration layer that first combines world and domain under a typed message contract.

acceptance_targets: Electron main process owns filesystem and window lifecycle; simulation runs in a dedicated worker (simulation-worker); renderer is presentation-only
Typed IPC contracts in packages/contracts; preload exposes only an explicit allowlist of channels via contextBridge; no generic invoke(channel, args) channel
Electron security config: contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false, sandbox:true in all modes including development
INV-29 automated test: reads the Electron BrowserWindow options from main source and asserts the three required flags
Minimal renderer: price chart via lightweight-charts, BRL balance display, buy and sell buttons wired to simulation worker, pause and 1x speed control
CI produces a working installer for Windows and Linux via electron-builder; installer opens the application window (even if nearly empty)
Permanent non-dismissable disclaimer in the UI per §20
proposals.title: Electron scaffold: simulation worker, typed IPC, minimal UI, and CI installer build
proposals.why_now: The spec mandates that the installer exist in FASE-1 in minimal form, explicitly because packaging problems (native module ABI, platform paths) discovered late cannot be fixed architecturally. The simulation must already run in a dedicated worker outside the renderer thread. INV-29 (contextIsolation, nodeIntegration:false, sandbox) must be green. The minimal interface (chart, balance, buy/sell, pause/1x) is a FASE-1 acceptance target. Delaying this risks discovering Electron integration problems after the domain is complete.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo scaffold is in place with workspace layout, TypeScript configuration, determinism lint rules (tested), and package boundary checker (tested). All package source files are empty stubs (export {}). No ADRs have been written. No nominal types, arithmetic, RNG, CanonicalEncoder, price generator, ledger, tick loop, save format, replay CLI, bench tool, Electron app, or installer exist.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core has no implementation; it is the sole dependency of every other FASE-1 package and the prerequisite for ADR-009 and the CanonicalEncoder, which the spec requires to exist before any StateHash computation.
